run_metadata.coverage_summary: DEGRADED RUN (network egress restricted, same as the 2026-09-08 run). All outbound WebFetch/HTTP egress was blocked by the environment's egress proxy: every external host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including example.com, confirming a blanket organisation egress denial rather than a site outage. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so no deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values or contacts could be extracted or verified. The only working external tool was WebSearch (an index returning titles, URLs and short snippets). Discovery was therefore limited to headline-level opportunities corroborated from search snippets that reference a buyer-originated source. Tier 1 (AusTender + all state/territory portals), Tier 2 (councils, GBEs/water corporations, universities, health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery + major-buyer portals: Transgrid, NBN Co) were probed via WebSearch only, not read directly. Everything captured is flagged headline-level and pending detail; every date/value shown is from a search snippet and flagged for re-verification. Stale results (e.g. CSIRO ATMs with March-April 2026 close dates, the ACT Northside Hospital IEOI which closed in June 2024) were identified and excluded. Nothing was fabricated.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of degraded run): every WebFetch call and every attempt to reach an external host was denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), including example.com, www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. This is an organisation egress policy, not retried or routed around per proxy guidance.

No tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened, so deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contact extraction was impossible for ALL entries; every tender is headline-level.
Tier 1 AusTender and all eight state/territory portals were reachable via WebSearch snippets only; full ATM/RFT lists and pagination could not be swept.
Tier 3 SAP Ariba Discovery: no currently-open Australian public RFP could be confirmed via WebSearch; individual postings are registration-gated and require an authenticated session (deferred).

Several strong-looking snippet opportunities were EXCLUDED for lack of a confirmable buyer or an open close date (e.g. an NT Dept of Logistics & Infrastructure tender with no title/id; a Nepean Blue Mountains LHD ICT EOI of uncertain status).
Closing dates for Wingecarribee RFT T-2026-11 conflicted across snippets (29 Sep vs 20 Oct 2026); recorded as null pending verification.
Buyer left blank for several Tasmanian and buy.nsw opportunities where the snippet did not name the buying entity (no inference made).
